entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm finally done with[n]my work for school...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm exhausted... I could really[n]use some de-stressing right now.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Do you want to meet at the[n]beach? So no one sees us...

entries.en: Wear your bathing suit. We'll need[n]to blend in with our surroundings.
